Engineers, AI developers, and training professionals require scalable environments that enable rapid testing, safe training, and repeatable validation — beyond the limits of costly and constrained real-world data collection. From early development to operational deployment, the market needs simulation solutions that support advanced sensors, complex scenarios, and time-critical decision-making. Our platform delivers real-time, physics-based simulation for electro-optical systems — VIS, IR, LiDAR, and SAR. It supports SIL/HWIL testing, operator training, and synthetic data generation for AI. With spectrally accurate, geo-specific environments, it boosts realism, AI reliability, and mission rehearsal. jobs.description: 3D Content - Tiltan Skip to content About Us Solutions Simulation & AI Training Geo-Systems 3D Content Operation Centers Products TOPS Majestic.ai T-SAR T-BAT AGM T-VERSE T-AWARE News & Events Careers About Us Solutions Simulation & AI Training Geo-Systems 3D Content Operation Centers Products TOPS Majestic.ai T-SAR T-BAT AGM T-VERSE T-AWARE News & Events Careers Contact Us About Us Solutions Simulation & AI Training Geo-Systems 3D Content Operation Centers Products TOPS Majestic.ai T-SAR T-BAT AGM T-VERSE T-AWARE News & Events Careers About Us Solutions Simulation & AI Training Geo-Systems 3D Content Operation Centers Products TOPS Majestic.ai T-SAR T-BAT AGM T-VERSE T-AWARE News & Events Careers Contact Us 3D Content 3D Content In defense, homeland security, and training, the demand for fast, high fidelity, and scalable geo-specific 3D content is mission critical. Modern simulation, AI training, and validation require realistic 3D databases that replicate complex real-world environments, providing sensor-based systems with essential data such as textures, materials, and other properties to enable immersive operations. Achieving a true digital twin involves integrating diverse data sources including mono and stereo satellite imagery, LiDAR, detailed mesh models, OpenStreetMap, and more to deliver dynamic and continuously updatable 3D representations at scale. This capability empowers organizations to accelerate training and simulation, enhance AI development, and supply operational systems with up-to-date databases. Tiltan provides 3D content generation services for visual databases, terrain modelling, 3D models, and feature extraction. These capabilities support real time simulation, geospatial analysis, and sensor-based system development. From large area terrains to detailed urban environments and airport infrastructure, our full spectrum capable databases support visual, infrared, and synthetic aperture radar. They include textured models, semantic layers, and complex animations, all optimized for real time rendering and analytical accuracy. With deep domain expertise and support for all major industry formats, Tiltan delivers high value 3D content tailored to mission specific needs. T-VERSE – A high-precision 3D visual content generation service delivering geo-specific, full-spectrum (VIS, IR, SAR) terrain and model databases. Supports real-time simulation, AI training and validation, and operational system development with feature extraction, semantic layers, and optimized rendering performance. We place immense importance on providing equitable services to all citizens, with a particular focus on enhancing accessibility for individuals with disabilities. We allocate significant resources towards ensuring that our website and digital assets are accessible, thereby facilitating improved access to our company’s services for people with disabilities. In the State of Israel, approximately 20 percent of the population consists of individuals with disabilities who require digital accessibility to access general information and services. The objective of enhancing the accessibility of Tiltan’s website is to create a more inclusive, user-friendly, and convenient experience for individuals with specific needs. These needs may arise from diverse motor disabilities, cognitive impairments, myopia, blindness or color blindness, hearing impairments, as well as the elderly population. The accessibility of this website has been implemented by _______________ The website has been optimized for accessibility at level AA. Adhering to the guidelines set forth by the Equal Rights for Persons with Disabilities Regulations, 5688-2013. “______________” Company, the provider of website accessibility solutions, has ensured compatibility with popular web browsers and mobile devices, with extensive testing conducted using Jaws and NVDA screen readers. In addition, the implementation of WCAG2.2 recommendations by the W3C organization has been carried out, further enhancing accessibility standards on the website. Hebrew: WCAG 2.0 guidelines for content accessibility on the Internet English: Web Content Accessibility Guidelines (WCAG) 2.0 The website has been made accessible in strict adherence to the “Web Content Accessibility Guidelines” (WCAG) ICT Authority’s guidelines for making applications accessible in web browsers. Switching to accessible mode is a straightforward process: An accessibility icon is prominently placed on the website, usually on each webpage. Clicking on the icon will open the accessibility menu. From the menu, you can select the desired accessibility functions. Please allow the page to load after making your selection to ensure the appropriate changes are applied to the display, if necessary. If you wish to revert the changes, simply click on the corresponding function in the menu again. Resetting the accessibility settings is also an option. The accessibility software is compatible with popular web browsers such as Chrome, Firefox, Safari, and Opera, subject to the manufacturer’s conditions. While browsing in accessibility mode, we recommend using the Chrome browser for optimal performance. The website has been designed with a semantic structure that supports assistive technologies and follows accepted usage patterns for keyboard navigation. You can navigate the site using arrow keys, Enter to select options, and Esc to exit menus and windows. For an enhanced browsing experience with screen reader software, we recommend using the latest version of NVDA. We have made several improvements and adjustments to enhance accessibility on the site, including: – Adaptation for screen readers such as NVDA and JAWS. – Clear and intuitive site navigation. – The content is presented in a clear, organized, and hierarchical manner. – Optimization for modern web browsers. – Compatibility with various screen sizes and resolutions. – Consistent structure across all pages (1H/2H/3H, etc.). – All images on the site include alternative text explanations (alt text). The accessibility software provides a range of essential functionalities to enhance the user experience: Adaptation for screen readers: The site has been adapted to ensure compatibility with assistive technologies like NVDA and JAWS. Flickering prevention: Moving elements and animations that may cause distractions or discomfort have been disabled to prevent flickering. Direct content access: Users can skip the main menu and directly navigate to the content for quicker access and improved usability. Keyboard navigation adjustment: The website has been optimized to enable smooth and efficient navigation using keyboard controls. Text size adjustment: Users have the option to increase or decrease the text size according to their preferences for better readability. Enhanced spacing: Adjustable spacing between letters, words, and lines has been implemented to accommodate different reading preferences. Contrast and color options: The accessibility software offers various contrast and color settings, including high contrast, reverse contrast, and black and white modes to cater to different visual needs. Legible font selection: The site employs legible fonts that promote readability and ensure a comfortable reading experience. Highlighting links: Links are visually highlighted to provide clear indications and aid in navigation. Reading guide: A reading guide feature is available to assist users in maintaining focus while reading content on the website. Customizable mouse cursor: Users have the ability to change the mouse cursor icon to a style that suits their individual requirements or prefere
